title: ynf.failure.v1
description: The data of an episodic memory ynf writes for each occurrence of a failure signature (ADR-008). Its subject is the signature, so ynm's consolidation clusters the same failure across items; each occurrence's text names its item, run, step and time. It is tagged occurrence, so ynm's dedupe and contradiction passes leave it alone and reflection still counts it, and tagged ynf.failure.v1, which is how to select it: ynm filters by tag, not by dataSchema.

signature.description: The failure signature, also the memory's subject: lower-cased, whitespace turned to '-', cut to 200 bytes. Kinds: sig/ci-diverges/<check>, sig/ci/<check>, sig/stuck/sensor:<name>, sig/budget/<cap>[/harness:<name>@<version>], sig/outcome/<outcome>, sig/egress/denied/<host>.

count.description: Times this signature has occurred on this item.

run_id.description: The run whose outcome produced it, when there was one.

model.description: The model of the step's run, when the runner reported one.

outcome.description: How the run ended, as the run reported it (error, budget, operator_error, and so on). Absent for a CI signature, which no run of this item's last step produced.

exit.description: The run's exit code. Present only when the step that wrote the record made the run.

bound_by.description: The cap that ended the run, when one did.

failed_sensors.description: The sensors still failing when the run ended, by name, in the runner's order.

failed_checks.description: For a CI signature, the pull request's checks that had failed, by name.

excerpt.description: The end of what the run reported about its failure (its detail or error message), passed through the secret scrubbing telemetry uses and cut to its last 1024 bytes, with a leading ellipsis when cut. Never ticket text or a prompt.

harness.description: The harness that ran, by name, when there was one.

harness_version.description: The harness's version, when the runner reported one.
